proposal.reason: Main change removes CollNet collective-network execution end-to-end: network/plugin/proxy CollNet paths are deleted (`src/net.cc`, `src/proxy.cc`). Additional substantive changes require kernel review (CollNet device kernels and function-table slot behavior now null/reserved), graph-search review (CollNet graph construction/connection removed), tuning review (algorithm slot 2 permanently disabled with model/table and tuner-fallback policy updates), transport review (CollNet transport implementation and connect flows removed), and device-topology review (NIC/topology metadata no longer tracks CollNet capability).
